Yes, **The Jean Coutu Group** is a Canadian company. Founded in Quebec in 1969, it operates a large network of franchised pharmacies in Eastern Canada and is currently a wholly owned subsidiary of the Canadian retail giant **Metro Inc.** [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jean_Coutu_Group)

- **Founded:** 1969 by pharmacist Jean Coutu in Montreal, Quebec.

- **Headquarters:** Varennes, Quebec, Canada.

- **Operations:** Over 400 franchised drugstores across Quebec, New Brunswick, and Ontario.

- **Parent Company:** Acquired by Metro Inc. in 2018. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jean_Coutu_Group)
